title: Prediction scoring compares against the tree the prediction was about
description: Absorbed from gvc final-review findings cfd74936 (high) and b8137057. jlv scores a prediction against what the done did once its item became runnable, but it runs the check on the tree that ALREADY carries the absorbed fix, so a correct 'this gates' prediction scores INCORRECT (A8). Score against the tree the finding was made on (the base, or the pre-fix head), and carry the answering model's identity through to the absorption and score records so scores are per model.
